claims.text: 源文事实：2017年6月《Attention Is All You Need》（v7, arXiv:1706.03762）原建议明确提出三项目标：将Transformer扩展至文本以外的输入输出模态（图像、音频、视频）、研究局部受限注意力机制以高效处理大输入和大输出，以及减少生成的顺序性。

evidence.quote: We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video. Making generation less sequential is another research goals of ours.

claims.text: 局部受限注意力处理长文本输入——状态：后续文献已有直接相关证据（整体对照原建议则只覆盖部分问题或条件）。2020年4月Longformer（v2, arXiv:2004.05150）提出与序列长度线性缩放的局部窗口注意力与全局注意力组合，以及空洞滑动窗口模式，处理数千token或长达32K字符的文档，并在text8、enwik8及arXiv长文档摘要（LED）中报告了结果。

evidence.quote: To address this limitation, we introduce the Longformer with an attention mechanism that scales linearly with sequence length, making it easy to process documents of thousands of tokens or longer. Longformer’s attention mechanism is a drop-in replacement for the standard self-attention and combines a local windowed attention with a task motivated global attention.

We first evaluate Longformer on autoregressive character-level language modeling using a com- bination of windowed and a new dilated attention pattern, allowing the model to process sequences of up to 32K characters on modern GPUs. We achieve state-of-the-art results on text8 and enwik8 benchmark datasets, demonstrating the effective- ness of Longformer in long document modeling.

claims.text: 条件差异与整体覆盖状态——状态：只覆盖部分问题或条件。Longformer的局部受限注意力验证仅限于自然语言与字符级文本任务（分类、QA、共指消解及文本摘要LED），且依赖局部窗口与全局/空洞注意力的结合，未涉及图像、音频、视频模态及非顺序生成，因而不能证明原建议全部条件已被覆盖。

evidence.quote: After pretraining, we apply it to downstream language tasks through finetuning and demonstrate that Longformer consistently outper- forms RoBERTa on a wide range of document-level natural language tasks including text classification, QA, and coreference resolution, achieving state-of- the-art results on two of these datasets.

We finally introduce the Longformer-Encoder-Decoder (LED), a Long- former variant for supporting long document generative sequence-to-sequence tasks, and demonstrate its effectiveness on the arXiv sum- marization dataset.

claims.text: 图像、音频、视频模态及减少顺序生成——状态：当前检索范围内未发现足够证据。已导入全文证据中未包含多模态大输入输出或非顺序生成的实验；同库2018年BERT与2024年1-bit LLMs无检索片段；元数据候选中2010/2013年图论论文早于2017年已排除，其余候选未导入全文，不能凭标题或摘要判断。
研究建议与下一步：保留非文本模态局部受限注意力与减少顺序生成为未验证缺口，下一步检索并导入针对视觉/音频/视频局部注意力及非自回归生成的后续全文；语义支持待人工复核，并由人工将上述有来源的研究笔记保存归档。
